candidates.locator: Book of Confessions 11.1 (A Brief Statement of Faith)
candidates.phrase: the one triune God, the Holy One of Israel
candidates.rationale: The Brief Statement names the one triune God directly as "the Holy One of Israel," asserting holiness as God's own identity, not a mere mention.
candidates.chunk_text: In life and in death we belong to God. Through the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Spirit, we trust in the one triune God, the Holy One of Israel, whom alone we worship and serve.

candidates.phrase: against the sovereignty, goodness, and holiness of God
candidates.rationale: The catechism states that sin offends "the sovereignty, goodness, and holiness of God," directly predicating holiness of God himself as a possessed attribute.
candidates.chunk_text: What doth every sin deserve at the hands of God? A. Every sin, even the least, being against the sovereignty, goodness, and holiness of God, and against his righteous law, deserveth his wrath and curse, both in this life, and that which is to come; and cannot be expiated but by the blood of Christ.
